option_relations.rationale: Tumors of the follicular infundibulum are benign adnexal tumors, but they are not directly related to Fibroepithelioma of Pinkus, which is a variant of basal cell carcinoma.
Clear cell hidradenoma is a benign sweat gland tumor, distinct from Fibroepithelioma of Pinkus.

Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma is a variant of basal cell carcinoma, but it is not the same as Fibroepithelioma of Pinkus, which is also a variant of basal cell carcinoma but with distinct histopathological features.
Trichoepithelioma is a benign adnexal tumor with follicular differentiation, distinct from Fibroepithelioma of Pinkus.
